requirement R1 An element with no children becomes one node of its tag as the container's only child; nothing is in the container before `render`
requirement R2 Children become nodes inside their parent's node, at every depth
requirement R3 Siblings keep their order and none is dropped
requirement R4 String children become text nodes, in order among the elements, with their spaces kept
requirement R5 Props are set on the nodes (id, className, title, input value, disabled)
requirement R6 Handlers are attached: a click runs the handler of the element and then those of its ancestors
requirement E2E Whole pages and random trees
